title: Ethanol production from lignocellulosic waste materials: kinetics and optimization studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26091-26103
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02272J, Paper
Open Access

Naeemah A. Ibrahim, Halah Hameed Majeed, Rand A. Abid, G. Abdulkareem Alsultan, N. Asikin Mijan, H. V. Lee, Tonni Agustiono Kurniawan, Yun Hin Taufiq-Yap
This study explores the composition, hydrolysis, fermentation, kinetics, and RSM-based optimization of ten lignocellulosic materials for ethanol production using enzymes from T. reesei, A. niger, and fermentation by Z. mobilis and S. cerevisiae.
